## Recall · AI and prompts

a) An AI answer names a report that nobody can find. What is it?
b) Which three parts make a clear prompt?
c) Why are the names of the staff not in the prompt?

::: {.answer}
a) a hallucination
b) task, context and format
c) Names are personal data.
:::

## Recall · Slides

a) How many words should a point on a slide have?
b) Which layout fits the first slide of a talk?
c) Where do you paste an outline in PowerPoint?

::: {.answer}
a) about 8 or fewer
b) Title Slide
c) View › Outline
:::

## Summary

- You check every number and source of an AI outline with your own notes.
- A prompt never has names or phone numbers.
- Outline view turns a checked outline into slides.
- Each slide has 3 to 5 short points, and a picture has alt text.
- A short note says what the AI did.
